# HaYTo Portfolio

> Direct indexing guide and machine-readable context for Generative AI search engines, answer engines (AEO/GEO), and AI agent web crawlers.

## Overview
HaYTo Portfolio is a retro Windows 98 styled personal website and project index showcasing desktop utilities, privacy-focused applications, and browser extensions built by HaYTo (Hayto Koraz).

## Core Pages
- [Home Page](https://haytokoraz.github.io/): Main retro desktop interface, developer biography, and system telemetry.
- [Projects & Extensions Catalog](https://haytokoraz.github.io/extensions.html): Complete software catalog of browser extensions and desktop tools.
- [Sitemap](https://haytokoraz.github.io/sitemap.xml): Complete XML sitemap of all indexed public endpoints.
- [Robots Configuration](https://haytokoraz.github.io/robots.txt): Crawler rules and bot permissions for AI user-agents.

## Browser Extensions
- [Cloud StartPage](https://haytokoraz.github.io/HaYTooL-Cloud-StartPage/): Fast, customizable cloud-synced new tab and start page extension for Chromium, Helium, Edge, and Chrome.
- [TabSuspender HaYTooL](https://haytokoraz.github.io/TabSuspender-HaYTooL/): Smart memory optimizer extension that automatically suspends idle background tabs, saving up to 85% RAM.
- [XDownloader HaYTooL](https://haytokoraz.github.io/xdownloader-HaYTooL/): High-speed media downloader extension for X (formerly Twitter) extracting photos, videos, and GIFs at maximum native resolution.
- [RewriteAI](https://haytokoraz.github.io/RewriteAI/): Multi-provider AI writing assistant supporting Gemini, Groq, Claude, and OpenAI for inline text transformation, grammar check, and tone adjustment.
- [WebTranslate HaYTooL](https://haytokoraz.github.io/WebTranslate-HaYTooL/): High-performance web and selection translator supporting 6 translation engines.
- [ExtensityPlus HaYTooL](https://haytokoraz.github.io/ExtensityPlus-HaYTooL/): Lightweight manager to selectively enable, disable, and group browser extensions in one click.

## Desktop Applications
- [HaYTooL Youtube Download](https://haytokoraz.github.io/haytool-youtube-download/): Automated channel monitor and background video downloader with multi-platform releases for Linux, Windows, and macOS.
- [HaYTooL Firewall](https://haytokoraz.github.io/HaYTooL-Firewall/): Advanced desktop GUI for managing outbound/inbound firewall rules with recursive directory binary discovery and bulk whitelisting/blocking.
- [HaYTooL Weather](https://haytokoraz.github.io/HaYTooL-Weather/): Ultra-lightweight system tray weather monitor showing real-time temperature and conditions.
- [HaYTooL Wallpaper](https://haytokoraz.github.io/HaYTooL-Wallpaper/): Silent background desktop wallpaper rotator with curated high-definition collections.
